title: GoThru Photographer API Go Project Report

issues.display_title: Issue #62: Expose Last-Updated Date on Photographer Detail API
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation — Expose Last-Updated Date on Photographer Detail API

Status: Done
Depends on: photographer-detail-updated-at-task.md

Endpoint

URL: /v1/photographers/:slug
Method: GET
Auth Required: No

Success Response (relevant fields only)

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "slug": "gil-fourgeaud-97jj",
    "fullname": "Gil Fourgeaud",
    "startDate": "2021-03-10T00:00:00Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-08-20T14:32:00Z",
    "...": "..."
  }
}

updatedAt is null/omitted only if the underlying DB column is null, which
should not happen for existing rows since GORM auto-populates it on write.

Changes

  • src/action/v1/photographers/getPhotographerDetailBySlug.go — added
    "updatedAt": phot.UpdatedAt to the result map (line ~185), next to the
    existing "startDate": phot.StartDate entry. No struct or query change:
    models.DirectoryPhotographer.UpdatedAt (*time.Time) was already loaded
    by the existing First(&phot) call.
  • gothru-photographer-v2/src/data/responseTypes.ts — added
    updatedAt?: string; to PhotographerDetailResponse["data"] so the
    frontend type matches the new field (frontend consumption documented
    separately in that repo's
    docs/implementation/photographer-profile-updated-at-display.md).

Known limitation (accepted, not fixed here)

Responses are cached in Redis per (slug, version) via
helpers.RedisKey.PhotographerDetail. Any entry cached before this change
deployed keeps serving the old shape (no updatedAt) until it expires
(RedisCacheTTL) or is naturally overwritten by an unrelated write-triggered
invalidation. This was observed directly: gil-fourgeaud-97jj returned no
updatedAt from a already-warm cache entry immediately after deploying this
change. No invalidation mechanism was added for this — bounded, self-correcting
staleness within RedisCacheTTL, same acceptance reasoning as
docs/implementation/issue-57-redis-cache-staleness.md.

Verification

  • go build ./... — clean.
  • Manual: GET /v1/photographers/:slug with ?disablecache=true (bypasses
    the stale cached entry for a single request) confirms updatedAt present
    in the response for a photographer with a non-null updated_at row.

Type: Feature
Source:

Requirement

The public photographer profile page has no indication of when a
photographer's profile information was last changed. Add a "last updated"
date, sourced from the backend, so the frontend can display it on the profile
page.

Acceptance criteria

  • GET /v1/photographers/:slug response includes the photographer's last
    update timestamp.
  • No new column or migration — reuse the existing photographers.updated_at
    column (DirectoryPhotographer.UpdatedAt), which GORM already
    auto-maintains on every row write.
  • No breaking changes to the existing response shape; the field is additive.

Out of scope

  • Redis cache invalidation for already-cached responses predating this
    change — those keep returning the old shape until their TTL expires or the
    cache key naturally repopulates. Accepted as bounded, self-correcting
    staleness (same reasoning as docs/implementation/issue-57-redis-cache-staleness.md);
    no manual reset tool added for this.
  • Any change to what bumps photographers.updated_at — see
    docs/implementation/issue-55-updated-at-bump-fix.md for the existing
    semantics of that column (it also bumps on ranking recomputation, not only
    on genuine profile edits).
